csv_project_name: Developer for NW 7th Ave Development Tucker Hill Section 2
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Ocala ( City ), through this Invitation to Negotiate ( ITN ) GRM/260683, seeks proposals from interested and qualified developers, builders, partnerships and/or agencies interested in constructing a residential development on the subject parcels to include a mix of single-family detached residential homes and an open space area. The City s intent is to use the property for the creation of Affordable Housing while maintaining quality construction and site design.

title: Developer for NW 7th Ave Development Tucker Hill Section 2
short_description: Developer sought for affordable housing residential development with single-family homes and open space.
project_scope: Development of residential parcels for affordable housing, including a mix of single-family detached homes and an open space area; no technical data such as gross floor area, unit count, or structural spans are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services for residential development, including development, builder, partnership, or agency-led delivery of housing and site design.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential housing development with standard single-family homes is generally low relevance for sbp.
- No indication of complex structural engineering, long spans, bridges, roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- Procurement is aimed at developers/builders rather than specialized structural design services.
- Affordable housing and site design may have some planning component, but the project type does not match sbp's core focus.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: affordable housing development on subject parcels with single-family detached homes and open space area; no unit count, floor area, site area, or cost benchmark is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated, and no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible because the tender is for developer/design-build services without defined structural engineering scope, construction cost, or service phases.
references_qualifications: Interested and qualified developers, builders, partnerships and/or agencies are invited; no specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: City of Ocala Purchasing Dept, Ocala, Florida, USA. Contact: David Williams. Phone: 352-629-8350. Fax: 352-351-6710. Email: dwilliams@ocalafl.gov. Website: https://www.prorfx.com/bids/RFP06232600000099
notes: Project number: GRM/260683. Questions deadline: 2026-08-06 05:00 PM EDT. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Source identifies target market as General Building and discipline as Design Build/Developer. This appears to be a developer solicitation rather than a pure engineering design tender.
